values.summary: Reconcile exact linkage-aware terminal GitHub truth and perform separate preview-first cleanup only for the exact registered canonical worktree after committed closed_out state and retained terminal receipt.

steps.action: Define finish truth tables and distinct checkpoint, terminal, external-parent-close, ambiguity, and no-PR receipt schemas.
Implement exact PR/linkage/readback reconciliation without selecting or creating a second PR.
Implement PartOf checkpoint completion back to implemented with retained evidence and invalidated review/publication authorization.
Implement the explicit external-parent-close disposition without crediting a checkpoint PR or requiring remote rollback.
Implement separate preview-default cleanup with canonical path equality and distinct live/dirty/mismatched/absent/unregistered/already-removed outcomes.
Require committed closed_out plus terminal receipt and exercise multi-checkpoint/closing, ambiguous PR, path attack, cross-worktree, and eligibility fixtures.
Complete finish reconciliation before cleanup, remove only the exact eligible registered worktree, and prove no other worktree/cache or unresolved terminal ambiguity was touched.

invariants: Issue V3-15 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: A passing artifact could overstate production, legal, or release authority.
Path or external-account overlap could collide with another active issue.
Evidence could become stale if it is not tied to exact revisions and producer outcomes.
stop_conditions: Finish trusts local prose over GitHub, PR selection is ambiguous, a `part_of` PR can close or terminally complete its parent, cleanup cannot prove exact path identity, or deletion scope includes another live/open worktree.
